description: Na₃BiF₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.21 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.21 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Bi is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Bi-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.31 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Bi atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Bi atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Bi atom.
